name: git-extras
description: Collection of Git utilities including delta, difft, GitHub CLI, tig, and git-lfs

delta.description: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and blame output with themes and customizable colors
delta.usage:
git config --global core.pager delta # Set as git pager
delta --theme=gruvbox-dark file1.txt file2.txt # Compare files with theme
git diff | delta --side-by-side # Side-by-side view
delta --plus-style='bold green' --minus-style='bold red' # Custom colors

difft.description: Structural diff tool that understands programming language syntax for better comparisons
difft.usage:
difft file1.py file2.py # Compare Python files with syntax awareness
git difftool --tool=difft # Use as git difftool
difft --language=javascript old.js new.js # Specify language
difft --display=side-by-side src/ dest/ # Directory comparison

gh.description: GitHub CLI for repository management, issues, pull requests, and GitHub Actions
gh.usage:
gh repo create myproject --public # Create repository
gh pr create --title 'Fix bug' --body 'Description' # Create pull request
gh issue list --label bug # List issues with label
gh workflow run ci.yml # Trigger GitHub Actions workflow

gitstatusd.description: High-performance git status daemon for responsive terminal prompts
gitstatusd.usage:
gitstatusd # Run status daemon
export GITSTATUS_DAEMON=$PWD/gitstatusd.exe # Set daemon path
# Used internally by powerlevel10k and other prompt themes
# Provides sub-second git status for large repositories

tig.description: Text-mode interface for Git with powerful browsing, searching, and commit visualization
tig.usage:
tig # Browse repository history
tig status # Interactive staging area
tig blame file.txt # Blame view with navigation
tig show HEAD~5 # Show specific commit
tig --all # View all branches

git-lfs.description: Git Large File Storage extension for versioning large binary files efficiently
git-lfs.usage:
git lfs install # Initialize LFS in repository
git lfs track '*.psd' '*.zip' # Track large file types
git lfs ls-files # List tracked files
git lfs pull # Download LFS objects
git lfs migrate import --include='*.bin' # Migrate existing files

git.description: Git distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code
git.usage:
git init # Initialize repository
git add . # Stage all changes
git commit -m 'message' # Commit changes
git push origin main # Push to remote
git pull # Pull latest changes

git-credential-wincred.description: Windows Credential Manager integration for Git authentication
git-credential-wincred.usage: git config --global credential.helper wincred # Enable Windows credential storage\n# Automatically stores and retrieves Git credentials\n# Used internally by Git for HTTPS authentication

git-remote-http.description: Git HTTP/HTTPS protocol handler for remote repository access
git-remote-http.usage:
# Used internally by Git for HTTP remote operations
git clone https://github.com/user/repo.git # Clone over HTTPS
git push origin main # Push over HTTPS
# Handles HTTP authentication and transport

git-remote-https.description: Git HTTPS protocol handler with SSL/TLS support for secure remote access
git-remote-https.usage:
# Used internally by Git for HTTPS remote operations
# Provides secure transport layer for Git operations
# Handles SSL certificate validation and encryption
# Automatically invoked for https:// URLs

gpg.description: GNU Privacy Guard for Git commit and tag signing with cryptographic verification
gpg.usage:
git config --global user.signingkey KEY_ID # Set GPG signing key
git config --global commit.gpgsign true # Enable commit signing
git commit -S -m 'Signed commit' # Sign specific commit
gpg --list-secret-keys --keyid-format LONG # List GPG keys

gzip.description: GNU compression utility used by Git for efficient object storage and transfer
gzip.usage:
gzip file.txt # Compress file
gzip -d file.txt.gz # Decompress file
# Used internally by Git for object compression
# Optimizes repository storage and network transfers

scp.description: Secure Copy Protocol for encrypted file transfers over SSH
scp.usage:
scp file.txt user@server:/path/ # Copy file to remote
scp user@server:/path/file.txt . # Copy from remote
scp -r directory/ user@server:/path/ # Copy directory recursively
scp -P 2222 file.txt user@server:/path/ # Use custom SSH port

ssh.description: OpenSSH client for secure shell connections and Git SSH transport
ssh.usage:
ssh user@server # Connect to remote server
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa user@server # Use specific key
ssh -p 2222 user@server # Use custom port
# Used by Git for SSH-based repository access

ssh-add.description: SSH authentication agent for managing private keys in memory
ssh-add.usage:
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa # Add private key to agent
ssh-add -l # List loaded keys
ssh-add -D # Remove all keys from agent
eval $(ssh-agent -s); ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa # Start agent and add key

ssh-agent.description: SSH authentication agent daemon for secure key management
ssh-agent.usage:
eval $(ssh-agent -s) # Start SSH agent
ssh-agent -k # Kill SSH agent
# Runs in background to manage SSH keys
# Eliminates need to re-enter passphrases

ssh-keygen.description: SSH key generation utility for creating authentication key pairs
ssh-keygen.usage:
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C 'email@example.com' # Generate RSA key
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C 'email@example.com' # Generate Ed25519 key
ssh-keygen -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa -p # Change passphrase
ssh-keygen -y -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa # Extract public key

ssh-keyscan.description: SSH host key scanner for collecting and verifying server fingerprints
ssh-keyscan.usage:
ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts # Add GitHub host key
ssh-keyscan -H github.com # Hash hostname in output
ssh-keyscan -t rsa,ecdsa github.com # Scan specific key types
ssh-keyscan -p 2222 server.com # Scan custom port

ssh-pageant.description: Bridge between OpenSSH and PuTTY Pageant for Windows SSH key management
ssh-pageant.usage:
ssh-pageant # Start pageant bridge
# Allows OpenSSH to use PuTTY Pageant keys
# Enables single sign-on with PuTTY key storage
# Integrates Windows SSH workflows

tar.description: Archive utility used by Git for creating and extracting compressed archives
tar.usage:
tar -czf archive.tar.gz directory/ # Create compressed archive
tar -xzf archive.tar.gz # Extract archive
tar -tf archive.tar.gz # List archive contents
# Used internally by Git for pack file operations
